test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some defects are problems.

Some problems are solutions.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some defects being solutions is a possibility.

II. No solution is a defect.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Least possible Venn diagram is given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f4ab8179f044961595c8ac18a3c58f5a71e730f002a1e7c35f1569fe2502d6.png] 

I) Some defects being solutions is a possibility → Follow → As some defects are problem and problem are solution so some defects being solution is a possibility true)

II) No solution is a defect → Does not follow → As some defects are problem and some problem are solution so no solution is a defect is possible but not definite follow)

Therefore,** only conclusion **I **follows here.**

Hence, the correct answer is** option(1)**
